channel.title: ☉ gpt instructions for cleaning my mac keyboard

text:
Use only common stuff:
1) Flip + tap
Power off, upside down, light taps
2) Toothpick / wooden skewer
Gently trace key gaps to pull crumbs out (don’t pry up)
3) Post-it / tape edge
Sticky side into gaps → lift debris
4) Soft brush (paintbrush / toothbrush)
While inverted, sweep gaps
5) Alcohol clean
Q-tip + ≥90% isopropyl
Lightly around edges
Tap key repeatedly
Tilt to drain, dry 30 min
6) Repeat 2–3x
Avoid
Removing keys
Paper clips / metal
Water
Pouring liquid
If still sticky: internal residue → replacement only.
